## What

The five-card first-run overlay (`#ntk-onboarding`) kept getting in the way:
it blocked the Backstory tab in testing on 2026-10-01, and its "Skip intro"
button did not respond to a click in the in-app browser (unverified why; a
scripted `.click()` did dismiss it). The editor decided to cut it from the
build and keep the code here so the good parts can be reused. Removed from
`digest/index.html`: the CSS block, the HTML overlay and the IIFE that drove
it (swipe, dots, `localStorage` key `ntk_onboarding_v3_complete`, `gtag`
events `onboarding_card_viewed`, `onboarding_completed`, `onboarding_skipped`).
Nothing else referenced it (grepped for the ids, functions and key).
Verbatim copy below, taken from the file at the commit before removal. To
restore: paste the three blocks back where they came from (CSS at the end of
the main `<style>`, HTML just before `<!-- BACKSTORY VIEW -->`, JS just
before `// ── BRIEF TICKER`).

## Why

A first-run overlay competes with the product promise (closure, no friction)
and was a repeated test obstacle. Stored here rather than in a README or
branch so it survives. Readers who already completed it have a stale
`localStorage` key, which is now harmless.

    border:none; cursor:pointer; padding:11px 22px; border-radius:3px;
  }
  .ntk-ob-btn-blue  { background:#0798F2; color:#fff; }
  .ntk-ob-btn-amber { background:#F2AE2E; color:#261F23; }
  .ntk-ob-btn-teal  { background:#01B2A7; color:#fff; }

  /* Skip */

    background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; padding:4px 8px;

    letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:rgba(234,217,197,0.4);
  }

### JS

```js
// ── NTK ONBOARDING ──────────────────────────────────────────────
(function() {
  var OB_KEY = 'ntk_onboarding_v3_complete';
  var obCurrent = 1;
  var obTotal = 5;

  function obShow(n) {
    // Hide all cards
    for (var i = 1; i <= obTotal; i++) {
      var card = document.getElementById('ntk-ob-' + i);
      if (card) card.classList.remove('ob-active');
    }
    // Show target
    var next = document.getElementById('ntk-ob-' + n);
    if (next) next.classList.add('ob-active');
    obCurrent = n;
    // GA
    var names = ['','beta','welcome','unlock','goal','feedback'];
    if (typeof gtag !== 'undefined') gtag('event', 'onboarding_card_viewed', {card_number: n, card_name: names[n]});
  }

  function obDismiss() {
    var el = document.getElementById('ntk-onboarding');
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.add('fading');
    localStorage.setItem(OB_KEY, 'true');
    setTimeout(function() { el.style.display = 'none'; }, 380);
  }

  window.obNext = function() {
    if (obCurrent < obTotal) {
      obShow(obCurrent + 1);
    } else {
      obDismiss();
    }
  };

  window.obComplete = function() {
    if (typeof gtag !== 'undefined') gtag('event', 'onboarding_completed', {cards_seen: obCurrent});
    obDismiss();
  };

  window.obSkip = function() {
    if (typeof gtag !== 'undefined') gtag('event', 'onboarding_skipped', {skipped_from_card: obCurrent});
    obDismiss();
  };

  // Touch swipe
  function initSwipe() {
    var stage = document.getElementById('ntk-ob-stage');
    if (!stage) return;
    var sx = 0, sy = 0, axis = null;

    stage.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      sx = e.touches[0].clientX;
      sy = e.touches[0].clientY;
      axis = null;
    }, {passive: true});

    stage.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
      var dx = e.touches[0].clientX - sx;
      var dy = e.touches[0].clientY - sy;
      if (!axis && (Math.abs(dx) > 8 || Math.abs(dy) > 8)) {
        axis = Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) ? 'h' : 'v';
      }
      if (axis === 'h') e.preventDefault();
    }, {passive: false});

    stage.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
      if (axis !== 'h') return;
      var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - sx;
      if (dx < -55) {
        if (obCurrent < obTotal) obShow(obCurrent + 1); else obDismiss();
      } else if (dx > 55 && obCurrent > 1) {
        obShow(obCurrent - 1);
      }
    }, {passive: true});
  }

  // Init
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (localStorage.getItem(OB_KEY) === 'true') {
      var el = document.getElementById('ntk-onboarding');
      if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      if (typeof gtag !== 'undefined') gtag('event', 'onboarding_card_viewed', {card_number: 1, card_name: 'welcome'});
      initSwipe();
    }
  });
})();
```
